name: Fallen Seeds II
source:
Fallen Seeds II continues the thrilling sci-fi adventure of Evod and his companions Ada, Lily, Sif, Ophelia, and Kaya. This second part delves deeper into the mysteries of Ulthar and brings the story to its climax. Players can either pick up where they left off in the first part or start directly from the second part with a quick recap of previous events.

Join Evod as he navigates the political intrigues and hidden dangers of Ulthar. The Anomalous Zone, a mysterious and perilous area, remains a focal point of the conflict, with powerful Galactic forces converging on its secrets. Your choices will continue to shape the story, determining alliances, enmities, and the fate of the characters.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109240/Fallen_Seeds_II]Steam[/url]]
